【Event Overview】Horizon Robotics launched the 'Kaka Xia' smart cockpit solution, integrating a digital AI Agent and an end-to-end large model for autonomous driving on a single chip. This enables the cockpit to evolve from a static product to a self-growing ecosystem. The system supports multimodal interaction (voice, vision, gesture) and allows users to customize scenarios via natural language, such as 'I'm a bit sleepy' automatically dimming lights and playing energizing music. OTA updates enable continuous skill expansion, like adding in-car karaoke or gaming. 

【Experience Value】From a UX perspective, this transforms the cockpit from a passive tool to an active 'agent', reducing interaction barriers by allowing fuzzy intent triggers. On-device processing ensures privacy and low latency, while OTA capabilities prevent experience stagnation. 

【Potential Friction】High chip requirements may limit full experience to premium models, creating feature stratification. The AI Agent's proactive decisions, if misjudged, could cause distraction or privacy concerns.

news.title: 座舱大模型：智能驾驶的未来引擎
news.summary:
【事件概述】极氪宣布自研Kr AI大模型与DeepSeek R1大模型融合，推动座舱端侧AI大规模应用。该方案将大模型部署于车机本地，支持离线语音识别、自然语义理解及多轮对话，无需联网即可处理复杂指令，如“帮我找一家评分4.5以上、距离5公里内的川菜馆”。同时，系统能根据用户历史行为（如常听的音乐类型、常用导航目的地）主动推荐服务，并支持通过语音直接控制车辆功能（如空调、车窗）。该融合模型还具备自我学习能力，能通过用户反馈持续优化响应策略。

【体验价值】端侧大模型消除了对云端的依赖，在隧道、山区等弱网场景下仍能提供流畅的语音交互，显著提升可靠性。主动推荐功能减少了用户操作步骤，使座舱从“指令-执行”模式转向“预测-服务”模式，符合直觉化交互趋势。

【潜在槽点】端侧模型受限于车机算力，复杂任务（如多意图理解）的准确率可能低于云端方案。主动推荐若过于频繁或不够精准，易被视为骚扰，增加用户认知负担。此外，本地存储的用户行为数据若未加密，可能面临隐私泄露风险。
news.summary_en:
【Event Overview】Zeekr integrated its self-developed Kr AI model with DeepSeek R1 for large-scale on-device AI deployment. The system supports offline voice recognition, natural language understanding, and multi-turn dialogue, handling complex commands like 'find a Sichuan restaurant within 5km with a rating above 4.5'. It proactively recommends services based on user history and learns from feedback. 

【Experience Value】On-device processing ensures reliable voice interaction in weak network scenarios, shifting the cockpit from 'command-execute' to 'predict-serve' mode, aligning with intuitive interaction trends. 

【Potential Friction】Limited on-device compute may reduce accuracy for complex tasks. Overly frequent or inaccurate proactive recommendations could annoy users. Unencrypted local user data poses privacy risks.

news.title: 智能座舱，才是大模型的真考场
news.summary:
【事件概述】文章指出，许多大模型在发布会上表现优异，但进入真实座舱场景后暴露诸多问题，如噪声环境下的语音识别失败、多人对话混淆、弱网延迟以及安全边界模糊。核心创新点在于提出“座舱大模型需通过四重考验”：1）噪声鲁棒性，需在风噪、胎噪、音乐背景下准确识别；2）多角色区分，能分辨主副驾及后排乘客指令；3）离线能力，在无网络时仍能执行关键功能；4）安全护栏，避免模型生成危险建议（如“开车时设置导航”）。文章强调，座舱大模型必须从“通用AI”转向“场景定制AI”，通过端侧优化和领域知识注入解决上述挑战。

【体验价值】该分析为座舱AI设计提供了明确的质量标准，推动行业从“炫技”转向“实用”。用户将获得更可靠的语音交互，减少误唤醒和错误执行，尤其在嘈杂或弱网环境下体验一致性提升。安全护栏机制可防止AI诱导危险行为，增强用户信任。

【潜在槽点】严格的场景定制可能限制大模型的通用能力，导致跨场景迁移困难。安全护栏若过于保守，可能抑制用户对创新功能（如AI代驾）的探索。此外，多角色区分需额外硬件（如麦克风阵列）支持，增加成本。
news.summary_en:
【Event Overview】The article highlights that many large models fail in real cockpit scenarios due to noise, multi-speaker confusion, weak network, and safety boundaries. It proposes four tests: noise robustness, role differentiation, offline capability, and safety guardrails. The solution involves shifting from general AI to scenario-customized AI via on-device optimization and domain knowledge injection. 

【Experience Value】This analysis sets quality standards for cockpit AI, ensuring reliable voice interaction in noisy or weak network conditions. Safety guardrails prevent dangerous suggestions, enhancing user trust. 

【Potential Friction】Over-customization may limit model versatility. Overly conservative guardrails could stifle exploration of innovative features. Multi-role differentiation requires additional hardware, increasing costs.

news.title: 新款问界M9正式开启交付，多项软硬件升级优化产品体验
news.summary:
【事件概述】新款问界M9交付，座舱核心升级包括：全新寰宇三连屏组合（10.25英寸仪表+两块17.2英寸3.4K高清屏），搭载AR-HUD抬头显示系统，实现多屏联动。软件层面，基于鸿蒙座舱OS，支持跨屏无缝流转（如导航从仪表流转至中控），以及手机-车机-智能家居的分布式协同（如上车后自动同步手机日程并导航至目的地）。语音助手升级为盘古大模型驱动，支持多轮对话和模糊意图理解，如“我有点冷”自动调高空调温度并关闭车窗。系统还引入“情景模式”一键切换（如“影院模式”自动调暗灯光、关闭车窗、播放电影）。

【体验价值】多屏联动和AR-HUD将信息分层呈现，减少驾驶者视线偏移，提升安全性。分布式协同打通了用户数字生活，实现“上车即延续”的无缝体验。盘古大模型驱动的语音助手能理解自然语言，降低学习成本，情景模式则简化了复杂操作。

【潜在槽点】多屏联动若缺乏统一交互逻辑，可能导致信息过载或操作混乱。分布式协同依赖华为生态，非华为手机用户可能无法享受完整功能。AR-HUD在强光下显示效果可能打折，且内容过多时易分散注意力。
news.summary_en:
【Event Overview】The new AITO M9 features a triple-screen setup (10.25-inch instrument + two 17.2-inch 3.4K screens) with AR-HUD for multi-screen interaction. Based on HarmonyOS, it supports cross-screen content flow and distributed collaboration with phones and smart home devices. The voice assistant, powered by the Pangu model, understands natural language and offers one-click scene modes like 'Cinema Mode'. 

【Experience Value】Multi-screen interaction and AR-HUD reduce driver distraction by layering information. Distributed collaboration creates a seamless 'continue on car' experience. Natural language voice and scene modes simplify complex operations. 

【Potential Friction】Lack of unified interaction logic across screens may cause information overload. Full functionality requires Huawei ecosystem devices. AR-HUD may degrade in bright light and distract if overloaded.
